description: Search HAL, France's national open archive of scholarly work, for articles, preprints, theses, conference papers and reports by words, author, lab, institution, domain, journal, funding project and date, with their abstracts, DOIs and free PDF links. Count a lab's or an author's output by year or type, export citations as BibTeX, look up authors, labs, journals and ANR or European projects, and start a workflow when a new document matches. No account or API key required.

hal_new_document_trigger.description: Runs when a document goes online on HAL that matches search text, is by an author, comes from a lab or institution, or is in a collection, portal, type or domain, with its title, authors, abstract, DOI and PDF link. Documents already there when the workflow is turned on, and new versions of old ones, don't run it.
